design_name: Source-prior warm start for OBELiX OOD discovery
history: Earlier whole-dataset RF-UCB and fixed-ranking results were known. This design changes the scientific estimand to sequential discovery exclusively inside the official DOI/composition-disjoint OBELiX test pool. No result from this campaign definition was computed before freezing.
target: OBELiX log10 ionic conductivity; higher is preferred

initial_labels.sampling: group-aware deterministic sampling repeated by seed

ood_candidate_pool.primary: all 110 canonical official-test compositions after removal of canonical train/test overlap
ood_candidate_pool.secondary: the fixed farthest-40-percent composition hard-OOD subset defined without target outcomes in hard_ood_composition_design.json

true_discovery.definition: the first ceil(0.05*N) candidates after observed target value descending and material_key ascending within each fixed pool
true_discovery.primary_endpoint: number of OOD acquisitions required to hit the true top-5-percent set
true_discovery.censoring: budget plus one when no hit occurs

strategies.thermoelectric_prior: same ExtraTrees UCB with frozen ESTM ZT source prediction appended
strategies.alloy_control: same ExtraTrees UCB with frozen Borg yield-strength source prediction appended
strategies.catalysis_control: same ExtraTrees UCB with frozen OCx H2 Faradaic-efficiency source prediction appended
strategies.shuffled_thermoelectric_control: same ExtraTrees UCB with the thermoelectric predictions deterministically permuted across target identities using seed 20260714
strategies.random_control: uniform random OOD acquisition without a model

acquisition.score: ensemble mean plus one ensemble standard deviation

inference.confidence_interval: paired percentile bootstrap over campaign seeds
inference.multiplicity: one named primary source edge; controls cannot support a positive claim

OOD_discovery_improvement_gates: paired bootstrap 95% interval lower bound > 0 experiments saved
mean experiments saved relative to target-only >= 25%
at least 60% of seed-wise paired effects are positive
RandomForest sensitivity mean effect is positive
none of the alloy, catalysis, or shuffled-thermoelectric priors passes all non-sensitivity core gates
OOD_discovery_rescue_crossing: target-only median experiments-to-hit is greater than ceil(0.10*N)
thermoelectric-prior median experiments-to-hit is at most ceil(0.10*N)
claim_guard: This is a retrospective sequential simulation on a genuinely held-out experimental database pool, not a prospective laboratory campaign. It can establish decision-level OOD utility under the frozen protocol but not field-wide or universal acceleration.
